presentation.label: MIDI GENERATOR
presentation.summary: Looping shift registers write the notes of the Octatrack's MIDI tracks.
presentation.overview: In the style of the Music Thing Modular Turing Machine: each MIDI track can run its own loop of bits, 2 to 64 steps long, which advances once per sequencer step. LOCK decides how often the bit coming round flips (64 random, 96..127 locked, 25 a slow slip), SCAL the pitch range around the track's NOTE (NOTE only to four octaves), DENS how many steps are notes rather than rests. A push of knob A writes the current sequence into the track's own trigs. The first phrase after a boot comes from the moment PLAY is pressed.
highlights: A 64-step register per MIDI track and pattern, with its own LOCK, LEN, SCAL and DENS
LOCK like the Turing Machine: noon random, 3 o'clock and up locked, 9 o'clock slips; FUNC snaps 0/64/127
Rests that loop with the phrase (DENS); NEI on the next track follows the notes
WRITE: push knob A to turn the phrase into ordinary trigs (MIDI TRACK WRITTEN)
Settings saved with the project; a new project starts with every track OFF
The step's locks, the LFO, TRAN, the arpeggiator and its KEY act on the Turing notes
usage: On a MIDI track press AMP, then double-tap AMP twice (ARP SETUP, then TURING). Knob A switches the track's Turing ON.
LOCK (B): 64 random, 96+ repeats, 25 slips (FUNC + turn snaps); LEN (C) the loop; SCAL (D) the range; DENS (E) notes vs rests.
Push knob A to write the phrase into the track's trigs; MODE OFF then plays it from the trigs.
PROJECT > CONTROL > MIDI SEQUENCER > TURING FIRST ON makes a single AMP press show TURING.

controls.name: MODE
controls.doc: TURING page knob A, per MIDI track: OFF leaves the track stock; ON lets its register write the notes

controls.name: LOCK
controls.doc: TURING page knob B, per pattern and MIDI track: the chance the bit at the loop point flips: 96..127 never (the loop repeats), 64 a half (random), 25 one bit a pass (slip), 0 four bits a pass; straight between (README table). FUNC + turn snaps to 0, 64, 127

controls.name: LEN
controls.doc: TURING page knob C, per pattern and MIDI track: the loop length in steps, 2 to 64 (default 16)

controls.name: SCAL
controls.doc: TURING page knob D, per pattern and MIDI track: the pitch range centred on NOTE: 0 NOTE only, 64 NOTE-12..NOTE+12, 127 NOTE-24..NOTE+24 (README table)

controls.name: DENS
controls.doc: TURING page knob E, per pattern and MIDI track: how many steps are notes: 0 none, 64 about half, 127 every step; rests loop with the phrase

controls.name: TURING FIRST
controls.doc: PROJECT > CONTROL > MIDI SEQUENCER, project-wide: ON makes TURING the first of AMP's pages (ARP, ARP SETUP, TURING) on every MIDI track

limitations: Chromatic notes 0..24 semitones above each trig's NOTE; scale stages come later.
Settings are saved per project as #TURING_T<n> and #TURING_FIRST lines that stock loaders skip, not per Part. The registers are runtime state; a STOP and PLAY or a reload keeps them.
The boot seed is read from DMA timer 3 at the first Turing trig; the timer's behaviour on hardware is inferred from stock's own programming of it, not measured.
Not tested: arpeggiator, NOTE parameter locks, incoming MIDI notes, Part or pattern changes while playing, timing under load, hardware.

tests.summary: Emulator only: verify.py drives the panel under the ColdFire port, reads MIDI OUT and checks every note against a model of the engine with a fixed test seed, then boots twice without it. Cycles, memory totals and hardware are not measured.

access.location: MIDI tracks: AMP's TURING page (knobs A MODE, B LOCK, C LEN, D SCAL, E DENS; push A: WRITE); PROJECT > CONTROL > MIDI SEQUENCER: TURING FIRST, under CC DIRECT CONNECT.
steps: Press MIDI and select a MIDI track.
Press AMP (MIDI ARPEGGIATOR), double-tap AMP (MIDI ARP SETUP), double-tap again (MIDI TURING).
Turn knob A to ON, then B (LOCK), C (LEN), D (SCAL) and E (DENS); push A to WRITE.
Optional: PROJ > CONTROL > MIDI SEQUENCER > TURING FIRST ON, and a single AMP press shows TURING.
